releases.title: Inhale looks sideways
notes: Heuristic fusion scores hot events that share a token
The embedding path still sees the whole hot tier
A fused body is replaced by id

releases.title: Edges fade
notes: An edge that touches a weak sleeper is marked stale and kept
That edge does not wake and does not answer Echo. Token overlap still can
A sleeper that still carries mass holds the edge past the seven-day clock

releases.title: Cold stays cold
notes: A sleeper's body stays in encrypted cold.bin
RAM keeps the id and the tokens needed to notice a strong seed
The body is read on wake, or when the id is asked for by name

releases.title: Direct recall
notes: Hot memory resolves an event by id without walking the stream
get_event, get_event_by_id, and the Raft commit wait use that map
A sleeping event is still returned by id from the cold tier

releases.title: Sleep & Wake
notes: Low-salience events exhale into encrypted cold.bin instead of being deleted
Signed events and the recent tail stay hot
A strong seed wakes a sleeper back into the resonance index
Health reports hot_events, cold_events, and wake_count

releases.title: Psycho & Grain
notes: Psycho: Factor-1 weight ablation on the resonance graph
Grain: barcode-to-SynthID identity verification in the kernel
Auth: AUTH_MODE, RBAC roles, API keys — no anonymous writes
Product image: API, modules, WUI, TUI — landing is a separate app

releases.title: Origin layer
notes: Source entity system and reputation-weighted consensus
Ed25519 event signing and provenance
Kernel source registry for Sensor, AI, and Human origins
